Description: The business provides professional consulting services in design and space organization. All client consultations are conducted either online via video conferencing or off-site at the clients' locations. The residential premises are used solely as a home office for administrative tasks and for the partial storage of clean, non-hazardous business materials, such as packaging and shipping supplies. No clients visit the home premises, no direct product shipments or walk-in retail transactions are conducted from this location, and no hazardous, flammable, or toxic materials are stored on-site.
